ev-material-breach.claim: Repeated failures legally constitute a material breach.
ev-material-breach.provision: A continuous failure to perform core obligations, or an aggregate error margin exceeding 5% in any two consecutive fiscal quarters, shall formally constitute a material breach, granting the non-breaching party immediate rights to issue intent of termination.
